goal: Identify original files, skeleton, animation and addon compatibility before repair.
steps: Parsed original BMD with external addon's pure parser.
Read glTF JSON and imported BMD/GLB in Blender background.
Tested BMD import both with and without legacy texture loading.
observations: BMD v10: two meshes, 39 bones, 7 actions.
Bone02 rotates in all actions; attack 3 span about 0.905 rad and four BMD vertices use it.
HD LOD0 has 291 vertices with Bone02 weight over 0.05; the GLB retains Bone02 animation channels.
Addon BMD import succeeds in Blender 5.2.2 with texture loading off; with it on, formats/textures.py fails because Pillow is unavailable in embedded Python.
Addon logs rest-vs-bind mismatch for 29/39 bones; visual pose verification remains open.
